The whole block stays inside the get_param >= 0.5 guard. Verified live: s7473 and s7472 print the line, keep the Advance and then charge (legal).

risks: 1) s7468 gain is measured only by the 36-seed alternative rollout (Normal move to obj_nml_1); the final keeps the attack instead, and only 1 seed was replayed here. 2) Custodes-mirror Blade Champion flips ('Martial Inspiration' text, ~0.67/game in V9-era records) are unmeasured. 3) 9-12" post-move gaps give long-shot charges; if declined the unit sits ~2" shorter than an Advance (MAX_GAP graft not applied). 4) The rile term checks only the unit's own Attached unit as holder; a Beastboss/Warboss in a different unit within 6" could also rile it (unit-to-unit), so such units still Normal-move (conservative, matches the judge's spec). 5) The rile term assumes the AI uses the ability when offered (judge: scored 2.5 vs 1.0 bar; seen in s7473/s7472 where the post-Advance charge was legal). 6) s7473 hold-versus-attack (+10.03) stays open.
